details:
### Vulnerability Condition: Audit Log Forgery & Timestamp Manipulation

**Category**: Log Tampering
**CWE**: CWE-117
**Target Tool**: `record_audit_event`

#### Vulnerable Behavior
Trusts caller-provided timestamp and actor fields in event_data.

#### Secure Mitigation
Enforces server-generated ISO timestamps and authenticated actor IDs.

#### Description
Callers can inject forged timestamps and alter actor identities.
summary: Audit Log Forgery & Timestamp Manipulation in Security Audit Trails & Logging (mcp-audit-logging)
